cases.description: A default a modifier kept is produced once, by its own read, and every later read of it answers the text recorded, reporting nothing again.
A read of a default whose own production is in progress is refused at once, whether or not a bound is kept: it answers the empty string and fails nothing.
As many counted reads of kept inputs as the bound lets stand at once each produce their text.
A counted read past the bound is refused: it answers the empty string and fails nothing.
A refused read is not recorded, so a later read of the same input that is not refused produces its text.
Own reads made inside counted reads are the walk's and count toward no bound, so they stand as deep as the nesting limit allows.
